
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/shenchuanchao/p/19118064" title="发布于 2025-09-29 08:38">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">.NET开发中3秒判断该用 IEnumerable 还是 IQueryable</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>在.NET开发中，IEnumerable和IQueryable是处理数据集合时最常用的两个接口。很多开发者对它们的选择感到困惑，但其实只需要掌握几个关键点就能快速做出正确决策。</span></span></p>
<h2><span><span>核心区别：执行位置</span></span></h2>
<p><span style="color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1)">IEnumerable：在内存中执行查询操作<br>IQueryable：在数据源端执行查询操作</span></p>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>选择 IEnumerable 当<span>：</span></span></span></h3>
<p><span><span>1、数据已在内存中</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 数据来自内存集合</span>
List&lt;User&gt; users =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GetUsersFromMemory();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = users.Where(u =&gt; u.Age &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">18</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用 IEnumerable</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>2、需要立即执行查询</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> users = dbContext.Users.ToList() <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 立即执行</span>
                   .Where(u =&gt; u.Age &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">18</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 在内存中过滤</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>3、使用LINQ to Objects功能</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用.NET方法而非SQL可翻译的方法</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = users.Where(u =&gt; u.Name.Contains(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">John</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
                  .AsEnumerable() </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 切换到内存操作</span>
                  .Select(u =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { u.Name, Initial = u.Name[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>] });</pre>
</div>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>选择 IQueryable 当<span>：</span></span></span></h3>
<p><span><span>1、需要数据库端过滤</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 查询被转换为SQL并在数据库执行</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dbContext.Users
                     .Where(u </span>=&gt; u.Age &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">18</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成 SQL: WHERE Age &gt; 18</span>
                     .OrderBy(u =&gt; u.Name);</pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>2、需要分页或聚合操作</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 只在数据库获取需要的记录</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> pagedResult =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dbContext.Users
                          .Where(u </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> u.IsActive)
                          .Skip(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span>).Take(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成分页SQL</span>
                          .ToList();</pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>3、构建动态查询</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>IQueryable&lt;User&gt; query =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dbContext.Users;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.IsNullOrEmpty(searchName))
    query </span>= query.Where(u =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> u.Name.Contains(searchName));

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (minAge.HasValue)
    query </span>= query.Where(u =&gt; u.Age &gt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> minAge.Value);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> finalResult = query.ToList(); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 单一SQL查询</span></pre>
</div>
<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>性能提示💡</span></span></h2>
<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>错误用法<span><span>：❌</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这将加载整个表到内存！</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> users =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dbContext.Users.ToList()
                  .Where(u </span>=&gt; u.Age &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">18</span>); </pre>
</div>
<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>正确用法<span><span>：✅</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 只在数据库查询需要的记录</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> users =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dbContext.Users
                    .Where(u </span>=&gt; u.Age &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">18</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                    .ToList();</span></pre>
</div>
<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>总结</span></span></h2>
<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>记住这个简单的规则：<span><span><span style="text-decoration: underline"><strong>IQueryable用于推迟查询执行到数据源端，IEnumerable用于内存中的操作</strong></span><span><span>。根据你的数据源位置和查询需求，遵循上述指南就能在3秒内做出正确选择，从而优化应用程序性能。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span>
</div>
<div class="clear"></div>
